meta.title: Moving the example support inbox to one shared queue
meta.lede: A short brief for the support leads. Background in [r1].
meta.foot: Source: an invented example. Replace every value with your own facts.

ask: We ask for approval to run a four week trial of one shared support queue.

spine.today: Three separate inboxes each have their own owner, and requests wait when that owner is away.
spine.so: Replies are slow for some customers and fast for others, depending on who is in.
spine.instead: One shared queue, worked in order by whoever is on shift, with the same templates for all.
spine.we_ask: Approve a four week trial starting on 2 March, with a review of reply times at the end.

points.title: Faster replies
points.text: No request waits for one person; the oldest request is always next.

points.title: Low cost
points.text: The trial uses the tools we already have and needs no new licences.

points.title: Easy to undo
points.text: The old inboxes stay open and can take back their requests at any time.

decision.question: Do we run the four week trial?
